result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders, so Anna gets 2 and Bob gets 1 in your example. The test class passes (4 tests, including a new one for this case).

- **Fix:** `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` (around line 6514). The subquery now has `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same filter the per-quarter and latest purchase order queries use. I also updated its Javadoc to say cancelled purchase orders are not counted.
- **Test:** `src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest.java`, new `cancelledPurchaseOrdersAreNotCounted`. It adds two cancelled purchase orders to the South warehouse next to one sent order, and checks that Bob shows 1 and Anna 1. I did not run the new test against the unfixed code to confirm it fails there.

Nothing is committed.
